issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case identifier `get_total_number_of_students()` while the UML, template TODOs, and the solution use the Java-style camelCase `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This naming inconsistency can confuse students about the exact method name they should implement and may lead them to search for or implement the wrong identifier.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the snake_case occurrence in problem_statement.md with the camelCase name used elsewhere: `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. Verify the textual description and any examples reference the same camelCase identifier to match the UML, template, and solution.
